title: Polynomial-Time Length-Limited Word Construction
statement: For every bit string $z$, the function that applies the length-limited fourfold iteration to the tail transducer output on the first component of the decoded pair is computable by a deterministic finite-state Turing machine in time $C(n+1)^c$ on every input of length $n$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not fully specify the tail transducer or the fourfold iteration's length test.
